rules: Missing periods are absent; null is never zero, and no value is interpolated.
A comparison uses only periods admitted for every compared country under the same definition, unit, frequency and territorial scope (all_country_common_periods / pairwise in the recovery inventory).
A series is never extended across an official break ('b') or definition ('d') flag; break_flags list the official flags and definition_compatible_floor the first admitted period.
Different sources (Eurostat vs SORS vs Serbian MinFin) are separate layers, never merged into one series.
Descriptive layers (annual_history, monthly_history, serbia_*) are not model inputs; observations.json, the frozen high-frequency snapshot and the macro-driver store remain the only model inputs.

frontend_contract.availability: historical_recovery_inventory.json (public/research-data/data-coverage/) → series[].admitted (first/last/periods) and series[].missing.periods[] (from, to, category 1–8, reason). Map categories to A–G with categorise() in scripts/data-coverage/historical-coverage-matrix.mjs.
frontend_contract.breaks: series[].floors.break_flags and floors.definition_compatible; show a break marker and never draw or compute a change across it.
frontend_contract.revision_status: record value_status / source_flag (p = provisional, e = estimated, b = break, d = definition differs) as published; flags are shown, never dropped.
frontend_contract.comparability: comparability.national_annual / national_monthly[indicator].definition_check and all_country_common_periods; when definition_check says levels are not comparable (bilateral FX), disable cross-country comparison.
